relations.text_en: Agreed to buy its Gamma Knife center stake (December 2025)

source.label: Encompass Health 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On December 31, 2025, we entered into an agreement to sell our 50% membership interest in Gamma Knife Center at Barnes-Jewish Hospital, LLC ("Gamma Knife") to our existing joint venture partner, Barnes-Jewish Hospital, LLC, for $17.9 million effective January 1, 2026.
